title: Order entry
description: How a local orders one thing at the counter, and what they think of it. One order per file, named after the order.

order.description: The thing, in plain English, kept short ("iced coffee with cream and sugar"). The filename is this, lowercase-with-dashes; the validator checks it.

region.description: Region slug, e.g. boston, stl-314. Must be registered in data/regions.yml, and the file must sit in data/orders/<region>/.

local.description: What a local actually says at the counter, in standard spelling ("Large iced regular.").

spoken.description: Optional. The same order respelled by the region's accent rules ("Lahge iced regulah."). A folk spelling, never a transcription. Only allowed if the region has an accent: file in data/regions.yml.

slot.description: Optional. A cross-city comparison key, lowercase-with-dashes (soda, water, long-sandwich). Orders from different regions that share a slot get compared side by side.

moves.description: Optional. Counter etiquette a newcomer wouldn't know ("It's cut in squares, not wedges.").

takes.description: REQUIRED, one to three. What locals think of the order, in their voice. Affectionate: with people, never at them. See docs/TONE.md.

mood.description: love = a point of pride; gripe = a fond complaint; shrug = locals argue about it and don't much mind.

line.description: The take itself, one or two sentences.

voice.description: Optional. Who's talking, as a type of person, never a real named one ("a lifelong Dunks regular").

register.description: Optional. Same as the lexicon: 1 = everyone knows it ... 3 = deep local. Gates the order by the thickness dial.

contested.description: Optional. true if part of the story is a "locals will tell you…" claim, like who invented it, whose is the original. Say what's disputed in notes.

sources.description: REQUIRED. At least one. No source, no merge.
